name: Distribb
description:
Distribb runs SEO end to end for your website. Connect your Distribb account and Claude becomes your SEO agent: it can run keyword research with real search volume and difficulty data, plan a content calendar, write SEO-optimized articles, and publish them straight to WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Wix, Framer, Ghost, or Notion.

What you can do from Claude:

Keyword research and SEO strategy. Find keywords with search volume and difficulty, spot content gaps, and plan articles that target them.

Content writing and publishing. Create, edit, schedule, and publish blog articles to your connected CMS. Update live posts and sync edits without leaving the chat.

Backlinks and link building. Distribb runs a verified backlink exchange between real businesses. Check your backlink status, see every link you have received and given, and keep your link building moving.

Rank tracking and analytics. Pull Google Search Console performance: clicks, impressions, positions, and top queries for any window.

AI search visibility (GEO). Track how often ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity cite your brand for the buyer prompts that matter, and find the gaps generative engine optimization should close.

Google Business Profile and local SEO. Monitor live Google reviews, reply to customers publicly, and keep your profile active.

Who it is for: founders, marketers, SEO agencies, and content teams who want search engine optimization, content marketing, and link building handled in one place, with Claude as the interface.

You need a Distribb account (distribb.io). Connect, approve access once, and every tool works against your own projects.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Distribb to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Distribb to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://distribb.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Distribb MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Distribb lists 18 MCP tools, including ai_visibility_report, backlinks_status, create_article, create_project, gbp_reply_review, gbp_reviews, gbp_status, get_article, get_project, keyword_research, list_articles, and list_backlinks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Distribb?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Distribb in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Distribb requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Distribb is developed by Distribb. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
